principle: AI components may add capability but may not erase the ordinary civic layer. Every smart component has a non-AI state and a named maintenance/exit responsibility.

components.ordinary_layer: high-contrast physical map, tactile/large-text information, stable place names
components.failure_mode: screen/network/AI can fail while physical wayfinding remains legible
components.material: dark steel + replaceable low-brightness display + tactile plate

components.ordinary_layer: visible staff/help location and telephone/contact information
components.ai_layer: shows current AI mode: active / degraded / human takeover / stopped
components.material: small steel/red-ceramic marker; not a decorative warning tower

components.ordinary_layer: plain-language printed/physical summary available at service points
components.ai_layer: versioned digital record and change log
components.failure_mode: responsible institution remains identifiable when digital system is offline

components.ordinary_layer: seating, paper forms, writing surface, water and human conversation
components.ai_layer: optional shared terminal / translation / assisted service
components.failure_mode: remains a useful table and staffed service point with all devices off

components.ordinary_layer: physical line, bypass route, entry/exit and contact information
components.ai_layer: live test status and robot/agent mode
components.failure_mode: test stops rather than converting the ordinary bypass into a test route
components.material: removable floor/edge marker, no permanent overbuilding before validation

components.ordinary_layer: printed record of what was tested, what failed, what changed and why it continued/stopped
components.failure_mode: historical record remains readable without live AI
components.material: paper/ceramic/metal modular panels + optional digital index

components.ordinary_layer: shade, bench, drinking water, charging where feasible, accessible clear space
components.failure_mode: no loss of basic public function
components.material: tree canopy / timber / weathering steel / permeable surface

components.ordinary_layer: shared work surface and notice board
components.ai_layer: local prototype demonstrations and reproducible civic tools
components.failure_mode: remains usable for workshops and meetings without digital systems
components.material: repairable modular table, open power/data conduits only where justified
